column1: # IRS SOI Congressional District Data documentation guides, section D ("Congressional District and ZIP Code Matching Procedures"):

column2: District boundaries are based on the 117th Congress.
column3: Eight states (AK, DC, DE, MT, ND, SD, VT, and WY) have only one congressional district, therefore the matching procedures are not performed on these states.
